comment: Browser-matrix harness config (card 7.I1, issue #49; doc 09 §8.2/§11). Every knob the harness needs lives here — the run script, the Playwright config and the page harness read this file, never a literal in code (doc 07 §9's config-driven rule applied to the test lane).

chromium.comment: executable: a path relative to the Playwright browsers root (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH or the default cache), or null to use @playwright/test's own revision-pinned binary (the CI shape). The sandbox evidence run overrides it via the executableEnv variable because browser downloads are forbidden there: the preinstalled build (Python-playwright's chromium-1200, Chrome for Testing 143.0.7499.4) is driven instead of the pinned 156.0.8078.4 — the report records the version + user agent that actually ran, never assuming parity. launchArgs: extra Chromium flags every lane launch passes (evidence runs happen inside containers: user-namespace sandboxing is unavailable → --no-sandbox; /dev/shm is 64MB → --disable-dev-shm-usage so rendering never stalls on shm allocation; both are harmless on a dev machine and in CI).
